data.description:
Data contains the information data. Each key must consist of alphanumeric characters, '-', '_' or '.'.
The serialized form of the data is a base64 encoded string, representing the arbitrary
(possibly non-string) data value here. Described in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4648#section-4

binaryData.description: BinaryData contains the binary data. Follows same key format as data

subjects.description: Holds references to the objects the role applies to

roleRef.description: References a Role in the current namespace or a ClusterRole in the global namespace or error

rules.description: Holds all the PolicyRules for this Role

immutable.description: Ensures that data stored cannot be updated (only metadata can be modified)
